text: 1. Cattār'; imāni bhikkhave kammāni . . . paveditāni. Katamāni cattāri? Atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ . . . pe . . . 2. Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . pe . . . [232.2]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. 3. Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ? [page 236] 236 AṄGUTTARA-NIKĀYA. Idha bhikkhave ekacco avyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . pe . . . [232.3]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 4. Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkhaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ? Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi . . . pe . . . [232. 4] Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 5. Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. Sammādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ . . . saṃvattati. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā . . . paveditānīti. 236.
